# Live parity report — Classic ASP oracle vs .NET 10 port

Page-by-page comparison of the original **LiberumASP** (Classic ASP) running as a live oracle against the
**.NET 10** port, over identical seeded data. Generated by `parity/compare.mjs`.

## Result: 50 navigable pages — **49 exact MATCH, 1 MINOR, 0 DIFF**

The single MINOR is **`sysinfo`**, which is *intentionally* host-adapted (it reports the real platform —
SQLite/.NET runtime/host — instead of faking the Access/IIS/Jet values; reproducing those on a SQLite/.NET
host would be wrong, not faithful). **Every other navigable page matches** on visible text, form fields,
`<select>` option labels, headings, and title. Zero code-level divergences remain.

This run covers the **full navigable surface** — public, authenticated (rep), admin, and the previously
untested *needs-id* pages (problem details/print/view, KB article + print, In/Out details/status/update,
moduser, modify-edit, confdelete, viewlangstring) plus the read-only POST handlers (results, viewreports)
and the landing redirect. Includes are not pages; the dead `reps`/`viewrep`/`delrep`/`default_german`
paths are not navigable; `setup.asp` is folded into the startup `DatabaseSeeder` (no page to compare).

## Test rig (both apps live, no Docker)

| | Original (oracle) | .NET port |
|---|---|---|
| Server | IIS 10 + Classic ASP, 32-bit app pool | Kestrel (`dotnet …Web.dll`) |
| Database | Access `helpdesk2000.mdb` via Jet 4.0 OLEDB | SQLite (`C:\lhd_parity.db`) |
| URL | `http://localhost:8080` | `http://127.0.0.1:5123` |
| Languages | all 7 imported via `setup.asp` | all 7 imported by `DatabaseSeeder` |
| Auth | admin gate `admin`; rep login `admin`/`admin` | same |

Oracle stand-up is in `parity/IIS-ORACLE-SETUP.md`. Two oracle-fixture steps were applied to make the
`.mdb` represent the **authoritative `helpdesk.sql`** seed (the plan's intended reference) rather than the
older shipped sample:

1. **Schema:** the `.mdb` was a partially-migrated 0.97/0.98 hybrid — `problems` lacked `due_date` and
   `first_response` (its `setup.asp` migration uses T-SQL `ALTER COLUMN` that Jet rejects). Added both
   columns so problem pages render (the original itself is broken on this `.mdb` without them).
2. **Seed data:** aligned `tblConfig_Email` to `helpdesk.sql` (added `CDOSYS (Recommended)`, fixed
   `Jmail`→`JMail`).

## Identical fixtures (seeded byte-for-byte into both DBs)

To compare the *needs-id* pages apples-to-apples, the **same records with fixed dates** were seeded into
both databases (`tools/fixtures.sqlite.sql` for SQLite; the mirrored one-off `.asp` for the `.mdb`). Fixed
dates matter: creating records through the UI would stamp `start_date = now`, diverging by seconds between
the two apps. Both DBs start from the identical clean seed (`db_keys (1,2,1,1,2)`, admin = `sid 1`), so the
fixtures get identical ids:

- admin rep (`sid 1`, `fname=Administrator`, dept 1, on the In/Out board);
- category 1 `General Support` (primary rep = admin);
- **problem 1** — OPEN, owned by + assigned to admin, due 2026-06-08, started 2026-06-01 09:00;
- **problem 2** — CLOSED + KB article ("How do I reset my password", with a solution);
- one public note on problem 1; In/Out board enabled.

This makes `rep/details?id=1` (and user/print/view, kb/details/print, inout/*) render with identical data
on both sides — including the non-zero-padded `DisplayDate` ("2026-6-1 9:00:00 AM"), which matched exactly.

## Port bugs found by this comparison — all FIXED

The comprehensive run surfaced real port-fidelity gaps (regression-covered by the 79-test suite):

1. **`config_help.asp` and `cfgemail_help.asp` were never ported.** Added `/Admin/ConfigHelp` and
   `/Admin/CfgEmailHelp` actions + popup views; restored the working "Help" link on the Config page (it had
   been neutralised to bold text) and fixed the live `/Admin/CfgEmailHelp` link in the email editor that
   previously 404'd.
2. **`modify` form** was missing the hidden `mLanguage`/`mLangID` fields (cat/dep/pri/status edit forms).
3. **`confdelete` back-link** was missing the per-mtype "Manage X" link.
4. **`user/details` and `user/view`** weren't setting their `<title>` ("Problem Details" / "Problem List").
5. **`config`** rendered the "Administrative Menu | Help" row once; the original renders it top *and* bottom.
6. **`adduser`** rendered the "* = Required" legend twice (duplicated between `AddUser.cshtml` and the shared
   `_UserFields` partial) and was missing the required-marker `*` on the New Password field (required on add,
   not on modify).
7. **rep menu / rep print titles** — see the Classic ASP whitespace quirk below.

## Discovered faithful-rendering behaviour: `<% = %>` whitespace consumption

Classic ASP **consumes whitespace-only literal text between two adjacent output tags**. Confirmed by raw
bytes from the live oracle:

- `rep/default.asp` title `<% = Cfg("SiteName") %> <%=lang("HelpDesk")%>` → **`Company NameHelp Desk`**
  (the space between the tags is gone; verified via char codes — `…Name`(101)`Help`(72), no `32`).
- `rep/print.asp` title `…<%=lang("Problem")%> <% = id %> <%=lang("Details")%>` → **`…Problem1Details`**
  (whereas the non-whitespace `" - "` around `HelpDesk` *is* preserved).
- `confdelete.asp` `<%=lang("Manage")%> <%=lang("Categories")%>` → **`ManageCategories`** (raw response:
  `viewcat.asp">ManageCategories</a>`).

The port now reproduces these joined renderings (concatenate without the space), matching the live original.

## Full browser visual sweep — every navigable page, logged in on both apps (2026-06-03)

Beyond the DOM diff, **every navigable page was opened in a real browser (Claude-in-Chrome), logged in on
both apps** (rep `admin`/`admin` + the admin password gate), and compared side-by-side. Technique: a single
foreground tab navigated between the two origins (`localhost:8080` oracle, `127.0.0.1:5123` .NET) — cookies
are per-origin so one tab holds both sessions, and a foreground tab avoids the background-throttle that
freezes screenshots of inactive tabs. All captured pages were **pixel-identical** except `sysinfo` (the
intentional host-adaptation) and three real divergences that were **found here and fixed** — each one the DOM
and attribute harnesses structurally *could not* see:

1. **`user/print.asp` — "Assigned To" rep name.** The oracle wraps it in a mailto link
   (`<a href="mailto:{remail}?Subject=Help Desk: Problem{id}">{rname}</a>`); the port rendered plain text.
   The DOM diff strips tags, so the visible text "Administrator" matched and it slipped through. Fixed:
   `PrintProblemVm.Remail` + the `Print.cshtml` mailto (subject reproduces the `<%= %>` whitespace quirk →
   `Problem9`, no space). The query already SELECTed `r.email1 AS remail`; the VM just dropped it.
2. **`viewstatus.asp` — CloseStatus `*` marker spacing.** Oracle renders tight `100<em>*</em>` (the literal
   whitespace between `<%=status_id%>` and the adjacent `<% If %>` is consumed); the port's Razor markup
   block `@if (…) { <em>*</em> }` emitted the leading space → `100 <em>*</em>`. The DOM diff turns *tags* into
   spaces, so `100<font>*` and `100 *` normalize identically and it slipped through. Fixed: render the marker
   via `@Html.Raw(… ? "<em>*</em>" : "")` with no intervening whitespace (`Lookup/List.cshtml`).
3. **`viewlangstring.asp` — row order.** Oracle's `ORDER BY variable ASC` runs on Access/Jet (and the
   authoritative SQL Server seed), both **case-insensitive**, so `accountupdatedtext` groups with
   `AccountUpdated` and `ASQLqueryhasfailed` sorts by `asql`. SQLite defaults to **case-sensitive BINARY**, so
   uppercase-`S` `ASQL…` jumped to the top. The DOM text diff is a multiset (order-independent), so it slipped
   through. Fixed with `COLLATE NOCASE` — verified **position-for-position identical (395 rows)** vs the
   oracle. The same systemic gap was hardened across all user-facing `ORDER BY cname/dname/uid` queries
   (lists + dropdowns) so realistic mixed-case data matches the oracle too.

Regression coverage: `tests/.../ParityFixesTests.cs` (3 tests); full suite now **82 green**.

### Attribute-level diff (`parity/compare-attrs.mjs`)

Because the DOM-text harness strips tags, a companion harness diffs the **attribute-borne** content that
should be byte-identical and is not route-dependent: `mailto:` hrefs, submit/button `value=` labels,
`<img>` src basenames, and non-empty text-input `value=` defaults. After the fixes it reports
**49 clean / 0 attribute diffs of 49 pages**. (It correctly treats `type=button` vs `type="button"` and raw
`'` vs `&#39;` as non-divergences — both render identically.)

### Visual-rendering note

The Chrome MCP renders correctly on this box; pixel-identical pairs were captured for the whole surface
(logon, register, both menus, all user/rep/kb/inout pages, every admin page incl. the gate + the "Access
denied" red box, pins/`nopicture.gif` images, the report table, the POST result pages, logoff). Earlier,
full screenshotting of DB-heavy *oracle* pages was limited by the 32-bit Access/Jet backend erroring
(`ADODB 3709`) under Chrome's concurrent loads; serializing to one foreground tab and reusing the live IIS
session sidesteps it. The .NET in-memory session resets on each server rebuild (re-login required) — a dev
artifact, not a divergence.

## Re-running

```
# 1. Oracle: parity/IIS-ORACLE-SETUP.md  (IIS + Classic ASP + Access .mdb on :8080)
# 2. Fixtures: apply tools/fixtures.sqlite.sql to the SQLite DB and the mirrored INSERTs to the .mdb
# 3. .NET:   dotnet run --project src/LiberumHelpDesk.Web   (SQLite on :5123)
# 4. node parity/compare.mjs        ->  49 MATCH, 1 MINOR (sysinfo), 0 DIFF of 50   (DOM: text/fields/options/headings/title)
# 5. node parity/compare-attrs.mjs  ->  49 clean, 0 attribute diffs of 49           (mailto/button/img/input-value attrs)
```
